{{Top|leg}}
'''Excavation droids''' or '''archaeological droids''' were used to excavate sites. [[Polis Massa Pria Assemblage]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] built a number of archaeological droids to aid at the [[Wiyentaah/Legends|Local Dig]] site to uncover remnants of the vanished [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]] species.
